control_basis: True merge base, not the GitHub API baseRefOid
change: Capture and replay CUDA graphs in chunks of 512 GGML nodes

correctness.scope: Whole-graph fusion cases with deliberately short chunk boundaries; this is not exhaustive graph, concurrency, or full-model quality coverage

benchmark.telemetry: One-second GPU power, SM clock, temperature, utilization and clock-event reasons
benchmark.decision_rule: Require both orderings to clear the gates without a telemetry confound before advancing; otherwise park as insufficient or inconclusive evidence
benchmark.calibration_adjustment: Finish one bounded opposite-order pair. Prior A/A prefill variation prevents treating one short prefill regression as causal evidence
benchmark.retry_policy: No repeated reruns of a marginal result

deployment: Unchanged; even a surviving native screen needs actual MTP workload and release-stack validation
